title: U-Pb Geochronology
consumed_by: Any instrument TAPP registering a U-Pb procedure: LA-Q/SF-ICP-MS, LA-MC-ICP-MS, LA-ICP-ToF-MS, TIMS (ID-TIMS), SIMS/SHRIMP.
notes: Layer 3. Overlays Column F on the five Module_Geochronology fields with U-Pb-specific examples and allowed values, and adds four fields that are specific to U-Pb and are not instances of any general TAPP field.
deferred: Resolved 2026-08-08: U-Pb tracer calibration, blank Pb composition, discordance-based rejection, MSWD, grain selection and CL/BSE screening are no longer deferred. Each is supplied as a Column F overlay on Module_ReportingCore, which is what that module was built for. The U-Pb-specific residue is the discordance metric itself, retained as 'Discordance Definition and Values'.
2026-08-08: 'Radiogenic to Common Pb Ratio (Pb*/Pbc)' was removed as a U-Pb extension and is now an overlay on Module_Geochronology's 'Radiogenic Fraction of Measured Signal'.
decisions: 2026-08-08: tier revision. See the field descriptions for the evidence. The two U-Pb demotions rest on Condon et al. (2024) prose; the paper's normative checklist is Figure 1, an image that was not machine-readable, so these should be re-checked against it.
Column I (Keyed By) added to every field 2026-08-11 under Rule 7; owned_columns gained "I". Module-owned, so the value is authoritative for all consumers.
2026-08-11: Keyed By revised under the strengthened Rule 7 invariants — every key in use must have exactly one 'defines:' field, and 'defines: X' is used only where another field is keyed by X.
2026-08-11: declares source_comment (Rule 6.11) so composition stamps field provenance into Column G of system variants. Documentation only — not read by validate_tapp.py and not part of the schema.

2026-08-25: Step 1 of the Description/Purpose split. Column B keeps the Description sentences; the Purpose sentences moved to consumer-owned Column J. Move only — no text reworded or deleted. Routing and rules in analysis/Step1_Routing_ALL_MODULES_2026-08-25.csv.

2026-08-25: Column J `Purpose` declared as an OVERLAY column, not an owned one. The module supplies a default Purpose that a consumer inherits on composition and owns thereafter — the same relationship Column F already has. Added after Step 1 stripped Purpose sentences from Module_ArAr's descriptions with nowhere to put them, because ArAr is composed into no TAPP: a module with no consumer had no destination for its own Purpose text, so the text was lost. Modules now hold it themselves.
